scope: Spécialistes SQLite, Swift/iOS, Python et outillage de développement vérifiable pour Swarmer

methodology.note: Les 60 résultats sont des emplacements de recherche, pas 60 revues intégrales distinctes; plusieurs URL correspondent au même dépôt. Les six lectures GitHub complètent dix pages Exa (notamment README GRDB, mal extrait par Exa). Aucun code téléchargé n'a été exécuté; aucune installation, mutation de service ou inférence.

searches.query: Official SQLite C API and Python sqlite3 documentation for read-only authorizer, online backup, transaction isolation and BEGIN IMMEDIATE for safe automated database inspection and migration agents.
searches.objective: Prioritize sqlite.org and docs.python.org. Extract concrete safe database APIs, WAL/transaction/backup limitations, authorizer boundaries. Exclude generic blogs.

searches.query: Maintainer documentation and GitHub releases comparing sqlite-vec with sqlite-vss for SQLite vector search in Python and iOS Swift applications, including maintenance or release updates published March 22 through September 22 2026.
searches.objective: Prioritize asg017 primary repositories and author docs; verify licensing, dependency footprint, current maintenance and exact vector/index limitations. Older foundations allowed.

searches.query: Official Swift iOS SQLite tooling repositories GRDB.swift and XcodeBuildMCP documentation for reliable database migrations, xcodebuild physical device builds, automated XCTest and xcresult receipts, with maintenance updates March 22 through September 22 2026.
searches.objective: Prioritize groue/GRDB.swift, XcodeBuildMCP upstream, Apple docs. Extract executable tool capabilities, host requirements and license; exclude tool aggregators.

searches.query: Official documentation for Python coding agents using uv Ruff pytest and PydanticAI typed tools, sqlite-utils Datasette and Alembic SQLite batch migrations, including release updates March 22 through September 22 2026.
searches.objective: Prioritize maintainers Astral, pytest, Pydantic, Simon Willison and SQLAlchemy. Identify deterministic build/test receipts and SQLite migration limits, not marketing claims.

searches.query: Official OpenHands Aider and SWE-agent repositories documentation comparing code editing, sandbox terminal execution, test results, structured API integration, local model support and license maintenance updates March 22 through September 22 2026.
searches.objective: Prioritize upstream GitHub/docs or research papers. Separate autonomous code-editing capability from benchmark claims; extract sandbox/runtime/API and license facts.

searches.query: Apple developer documentation Xcode 26 coding intelligence MCP server xcodebuild xcresulttool Swift Testing XCTest command line physical iPhone testing 2026.
searches.objective: Prioritize Apple developer and Swift.org primary sources. Verify supported programmatic build/test APIs, simulator versus physical-device constraints, artifacts and Xcode version requirements.
